jobs.description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Principal Engineer Verification on our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Serve as the primary technical resource for the verification team, providing expert guidance. Act as the central liaison to other verification and methodology teams at Infineon to coordinate strategies and resolve issues centrally- Lead and execute end-to-end verification of IPs and their integration using best-in-class methodologies (e.g., formal verification, AI-assisted testing) to maximize quality while minimizing time and effort- Lead and review the third-party’s verification methodology and execution, from planning through implementation to final sign-off. Drive vendor accountability to close gaps and meet milestone targets, ensuring integration readiness- Actively guide and support the Chip Verification team in verifying the integrated IPs, with a focus on interoperability aspects and improvement of the methodologies in place. Serve as a direct interface to the IP team to accelerate issue resolution- Define automation frameworks and reusability strategies to accelerate the verification of derivative products- Act as a cross-site and cross-team bridge, connecting various engineering disciplines and sites to minimize verification efforts and late findings. Proactively drive the availability and quality of design infeeds through reviews and early engagementYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field- 7+ years in ASIC, SoC, or FPGA functional verification with ownership of complex block, subsystem, or chip-level deliverables- Expert proficiency in SystemVerilog, UVM, object-oriented testbench architecture, constrained-random verification, functional coverage, and assertion-based verification- Ability to translate specifications and microarchitecture into verification plans, environments, tests, checkers, coverage models, and** sign-off evidence**- Excellent** knowledge of English**, both written and spoken; German is a plus- Experience in power-aware verification using UPF- Experience** applying formal verification methodologies and portable stimulus for test development**- Strong debugging skills with a major simulation and debug toolchain and proficiency in Linux development and scripting or programming with Python, Tcl, Bash, C, or C++ for automation- Experience in practical use of AI and development of AI agents- Deep understanding of chip architecture, specifically regarding CPUs, port multiplexing, power management, bus systems and access protection schemes- Proactive participation in concept and design reviews to ensure quality and verifiability, along with a demonstrated commitment to self-improvement and continuous learning - Experience with** RTL design and digital architecture **with practical knowledge of sign-off readiness- Experience with continuous integration flows- Experience with emulation#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1874104

jobs.description: html Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH with more than 200 employees is a subsidiary of the Octapharma group founded in 1997 and successfully expanding. Our core business is the development of recombinant proteins produced in human cell lines for therapeutic use in humans. We strive for effective treatments with an improved tolerability and convenience for our patients.Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.We are looking for anExpert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)to join the Automation and Data Management unit within the Research and Development Department at Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH.The Automation and Data Management unit is responsible for the development, evaluation and long-term maintenance of automation- and data-driven solutions across R&D. The unit supports scientific projects by combining laboratory automation, data management, bioinformatics and scientific computing, and is involved in the work of multiple research units and virtually all projects within the department.The successful candidate will take on a challenging and versatile role with a strong focus on scientific computing, molecular modelling and high-performance computing (HPC). The position combines the application of computational methods to biological research questions with hands-on responsibility for the administration and strategic development of on-site Linux-based HPC infrastructure. Working closely with interdisciplinary research teams from all R&D units and Corporate IT, the candidate will ensure reliable and secure HPC operations while developing computational solutions to support scientific research. The role also includes contributions to internal data science and machine learning projects, with opportunities to develop expertise in new scientific and technical areas.Your main tasks and responsibilities- Development and application of molecular modelling approaches and molecular dynamics simulations to support scientific research, including protein characterization and developability studies- Administration, maintenance, optimization and strategic development of a Linux-based HPC infrastructure, including workload management and operational reliability- Development and maintenance of scripts and robust, reproducible, scalable workflows for scientific data processing, modelling and analysis, including testing and documentation- Contribution to internal data science and machine learning projects, including the evaluation and application of new computational approaches- Scientific and technical support of interdisciplinary research teams, translating research requirements into suitable computational solutions- Contribution to the integration and further development of data management, scientific computing and laboratory automation workflowsYour expertise and ideal skill set- PhD in Life Sciences with a strong focus on Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biophysics or a related scientific discipline; postdoctoral experience is considered a plus. Candidates with an M.Sc. and extensive, highly relevant professional experience may also be considered- Practical experience in molecular modelling and molecular dynamics simulations of biological systems; hands-on experience with Molecular Operating Environment (MOE) is highly desirable- Strong programming skills in Python, particularly in scientific computing, data processing and analysis- Proven experience administering Linux-based HPC or cluster environments, including SLURM or comparable workload management systems, with a sound understanding of performance optimization and the ability to troubleshoot independently- Experience in planning, extending or optimizing scientific computing infrastructure is considered a plus- Experience in laboratory automation or the integration of automated laboratory systems with data processing workflows is considered a plus- Interest in machine learning and willingness to explore new scientific and technical topics- Experience with electronic laboratory management systems, such as ELN, LIMS or sample management solutions (e.g. Benchling or comparable platforms), is considered a plus- Practical experience with version control systems and workflow automation (CI/CD); familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is considered a plus- Independent and structured working style, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent communication and collaboration skills in an interdisciplinary environment- Fluent English skills; a good command of German is considered a plusThrive with us- A permanent position in full-time (40 hrs./week) in a dynamically growing company- A modern, "state of the art" working environment- Flexible working hours- Regular opportunities for further training- 30 days vacation- Own company restaurant with subsidies- Free drinks such as coffee, tea and water- Job ticket or parking space for bicycle or car- An international team in an international corporate environment- A collegial environment with many opportunities for activitiesAbout OctapharmaOctapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines.
